config.note: All overrides fixed before execution. Original pretrained weights not used. Checkpoints, HDF5 data and private full subprocess logs stay outside public site; hashes, actual losses, sampled text and commands are published.

notes.losses: Training minibatch cross-entropy that upstream train_transformer.py appends for each optimizer update (index 0 = update 1). Not a validation loss.
notes.before_after: Upstream final estimate_loss(model, config, 200): mean over 200 batches per split. dev is the end of the same 96-line file, which shares its template and vocabulary with train; it is not a generalization or quality measure.
notes.periodic_eval: A periodic checkpoint stores the latest periodic estimate (eval_iters batches per split), made at periodic_eval.zero_based_step, not at the checkpoint's own step.
notes.generation: generate_text.load_trained_model + model.generate, top_k 1 (greedy), the prompt's seed set before loading. text = safe_decode of every id, prompt included and nothing trimmed: ids outside the tokenizer (embedding padding rows) are skipped in text but kept in token_ids, the <|endoftext|> id decodes to its literal string, invalid UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD.
notes.state_sha256: SHA-256 over 'studio-yebisu/state-sha256/v1\n', then for each tensor name in sorted order: 'name\tdtype\tshape\tbyte_count\n' and the raw CPU bytes.
notes.seconds: Wall-clock seconds of each command on the machine that ran it; not a benchmark.
